items.text: ____is a serious problem in many parts of the world, with factories producing illegal copies of top brand names.
It was a serious case of ____. The designs for the new aircraft were photographed illegally and sold to a rival company.
____is a problem for people who make a living writing books. Illegal editions mean that the author receives no payment.
____is a huge international problem, as police and banks try to trace money from the illegal drugs trade and terrorism.
There is a big ____in the importation of untaxed luxury cars in some countries.
